title: Serve Orchestrator Implementation
description: Implement serve orchestrator command per docs/plans/21-serve-orchestrator.md. Wires existing building blocks (SandboxControl, AgentServiceClient, AgentLoopService) into flexagent serve orchestrator — a process that accepts client RPC requests, manages sandbox lifecycle per session, and proxies or runs agent loops depending on per-session placement mode (agent-direct, agent-sandbox, tools-sandbox).
